scope.summary: All six change groups only set pointers to NULL after they are freed. They do not change any API signature, accepted input, return value or ownership contract that the harness relies on. The harness reaches every changed path except cJSON_free, which it does not call. No blocker was found. The build foundation stays unknown because build.sh delegates to fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh, which was not supplied.

assessments.reason: cJSON_Delete now sets valuestring and string to NULL after deallocating them. Its behavior is otherwise the same. The harness calls cJSON_Delete on every successfully parsed tree.
